title: tcg-card-collector export (format_version 1)
description: Validates a hand edit while it's typed — see ADR 0019. Point your editor at this file with a top-level "$schema" comment isn't valid JSON, so most editors match it by filename glob instead; check your editor's JSON-schema-association setting.

format_version.description: Bumps only when a section's shape changes in a way an importer must branch on (ADR 0019).

exported_on.description: The date this file was exported, informational only — not read by import.

inventory_planning.description: Optional, and each of the three fields below is independently optional: a field absent from the file leaves that table untouched on import; present (even with an empty array) replaces it.

rules.description: Cascade order, first match wins — the array's own order is the position, so it round-trips even though nothing here names it.

insights.description: Optional: absent leaves target sets untouched on import; present replaces them, even with an empty array.

rule.description: A location rule's DSL text, exactly as Inventory Planning's own parser and printer read and write it (docs/dev/domain-ubiquitous-language.md) — this file never re-interprets it.

location.description: A fixed name, or a template using {set_code}/{set_family}/{color_identity}/{type}.

match.description: The rule's expression, e.g. "rarity >= rare and finish = foil".

sort.description: Comma-separated sort keys, e.g. "color_identity,type,name"; empty keeps incoming order.

placedEntry.description: One placed-ledger row: how many copies of a key currently sit in a location.

collector_number.description: Kept as text: values like "10a" or "★" are not numbers.
